items.summary: test(database): isolate PostgreSQL Git backup fixture lifecycle Reinstall the fixture environment before each case because Vitest clears beforeAll env stubs before the first test. Keep offline custody on the same state root that backup discovery and exports exercise. Prepare the initial six-store backup in its own bounded setup hook and retain every discovery, redaction, refresh, history and restore assertion. Join the original async test bodies through the existing fixture lifetime so a timed-out backup settles before another case or database teardown.

items.title: refactor(runtime): consume canonical config and supported APIs (#175517)
items.summary: refactor(runtime): consume canonical config and supported APIs (#175517) * refactor(runtime): remove retired compatibility paths Consume canonical TTS provider maps, required supported-runtime APIs and V2 state methods in bundled adapters. Remove private forwarding aliases and unreachable fallback paths without changing public SDK exports or persisted formats. Keep Doctor transforms, update compatibility and supported old data. Best-effort tradeoffs accepted: - Direct callers supplying retired flat TTS blocks must normalize them through Doctor; internal synthesis producers now construct the canonical map. - Unsupported runtimes and incompatible pinned-dependency replacements no longer get speculative API-absence fallbacks; supported APIs are required directly. - Bundled adapters require the current host. Closed bounded-store runtime references reject through V2 instead of continuing against a retired runtime. - A non-protocol bare node.invoke reply is an ordinary Logbook capture failure; the supported payload and payloadJSON envelopes remain accepted. No schema, retention, durability, security-policy, protocol, dependency or standalone session-memory backend changes. This is the single below-500 z29 residue for coordinator bundling, not a claim of exact-head hosted CI proof. Local proof gap: lint-suppressions is 13/14 because the unchanged MCP lifecycle fixture contains two directives absent from its unchanged allowlist. Both file blobs match base and current main; this cut adds no suppressions. Archive/state worker suites remain pending after resource-budget cancellations. * refactor(runtime): separate bundled state adapter cut Keep the reviewed runtime/TTS/API-floor cleanup in this PR and move the bundled V2 state adapters to a separate area PR. No new runtime behavior. * test: align runtime cleanup fixtures with supported APIs * refactor: isolate catalog-reachable cleanup pending proof * test: preserve protected session memory coverage unchanged
